Info

Factory instantiating TimingLintRule components.

class scaralang.core.service.linter.rules.timing.timing_lint_rule_factory.TimingLintRuleFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing configured TimingLintRule instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Creates an instance of TimingLintRule with injected validators.
create_default - Creates an instance of TimingLintRule with default validators.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
classmethod create(*, dwell_validator: ITimingDwellValidator, blend_zone_validator: ITimingBlendZoneValidator) → IScaraLintRule[source]¶

Builds and returns an IScaraLintRule instance for timing validation.

Parameters:

  • dwell_validator – Required ITimingDwellValidator instance.

  • blend_zone_validator – Required ITimingBlendZoneValidator instance.

Returns:

Configured IScaraLintRule instance.

None.
